# LUNO Mwanajando

> LUNO Mwanajando is a digital ledger for bodaboda (motorcycle) and bajaj (three-wheeler) hire-purchase in Tanzania. It records every payment between a driver and a vehicle owner, shows live ownership progress and a projected "freedom date," and replaces paper notebooks and disputed receipts with digital proof. LUNO is the ledger, not the lender: it does not lend money or set terms — owners and drivers agree on their own hire-purchase deal, and LUNO keeps one trusted, shared record for both sides.

Key facts:
- Market: Tanzania's bodaboda and bajaj hire-purchase economy (East Africa)
- Users: drivers paying toward ownership, and fleet owners managing vehicles and collections
- Languages: fully bilingual — Swahili and English
- Without internet: on Android, payments can be recorded with no connection; they are saved on the phone and sync when back online. On iPhone, saved records can be viewed offline; recording a payment needs a connection.
- Price: free to download; free during early access for drivers and owners
- Company: LUNO Mwanajando Technologies Co. Limited, Dar es Salaam, Tanzania

## Download the app
Free to download on Android and iPhone.
- [Android — Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.lunomj.driver)
- [iPhone — App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/luno-mwanajando/id6782275114)
